title: AI Software Engineer (AI Lab)
description: About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company . Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule. C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Firmware Engineer on the Manufacturing Test team you will develop new platforms to interact with our products at the lowest levels (I2C, SPI, CAN, UART, USB, etc). You will work within an interdisciplinary product development team, delivering a streamlined solution for test execution and automation. Your code will ensure that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. You will build features targeted at embedded Linux, NIX, and several RTOS platforms. You will debug and solve complex data acquisition challenges in analog and digital realms. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Build things that test things. Utilize your expertise in firmware/software development to anticipate failure modes and build code for host/client verification of form, fit, function.

• Develop low-level firmware/software for microcontroller platforms interfacing to robots, or control algorithms for OTS Data acquisition tools.

• Build capability for device side validation of system-level features, utilizing SSH, gRPC, while creating or leveraging existing debug tools.

• Quickly debug and troubleshoot issues that span the electrical, firmware, and software boundaries, and transfer that process to automated test and failure analysis SOPs for production line staff.

• Engage in DFT/DFM reviews with electrical engineering and product firmware teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• BS or MS in CS/CE/EE or equivalent industry experience

• Strong C coding ability for embedded systems

• Experience integrating microcontrollers with analog and digital sensors

• Experience developing firmware in bare-metal, RTOS environments, and embedded Linux

• Solid understanding and application of coding best practices, board bring up and debugging

• Some familiarity with common bus protocols such as USB, SPI, I2C, CAN, RS232, RS485, Ethernet, etc.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance 

•

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bring up and Debug expertise for new designs, comfortable with low and high-speed interfaces

• Strong fundamentals for data acquisition and analysis (FFT, Bode, control loops)

• Experience with one or more microcontroller cores (ARM, AVR, MSP430, PIC, etc.)

• Experience with embedded Linux development and deployment process

• Debugging skills with JTAG, SWD, Oscilloscopes, and Logic analyzers

• Have a bias for action. If you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it

• Be naturally curious about the technologies and tools you use

Lila is hiring a Scientific Leader to build and run our experimental soft materials team, covering formulations, polymers, colloids, gels, emulsions, inks, adhesives, and coatings. You will take on a group of four scientists and grow it as the portfolio expands across formulation, rheological and scattering characterization, and polymer processing. • Experience leading scientific teams, whether as a formal manager or as a technical lead with direct responsibility for others' work

• Deep soft-matter fundamentals: phase behavior, self-assembly, rheology, interfacial phenomena, colloid and dispersion stability, transport, cure and crosslinking

• Hands-on record formulating and characterizing multicomponent systems and translating structure-property relationships into performance

• Demonstrated delivery against external milestones with industrial partners or sponsored programs

• Data-centric experimental practice: DoE, high-throughput methods, structured capture, and working with ML colleagues as a peer rather than a customer

• Comfort moving between strategy and bench-level troubleshooting, and leading a team split across multiple sites

• Experience taking formulations from lab through scale-up and manufacturability review

title: Manager, Sales Development & Enablement
description:
ABOUT STREAM

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Manager, Sales Development & Enablement to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the SDR team's targets, its people, and the enablement program that decides how fast new reps ramp.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in our Boulder office, with 3 days a week in the office.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

You'll lead a team of 6+ SDRs and report to the VP of Revenue Operations. Half of this job is management: coaching, hiring, and holding the team to its number. The other half is enablement: you own the onboarding curriculum, certification and playbook, so you build how the team works instead of inheriting it. You'll work closely with Account Executives and Sales leadership on pipeline quality, and with Marketing, Product Marketing and Sales Engineering to keep messaging current as we ship. Success is measured by team quota attainment, ramp time, and the quality of the pipeline the team hands to AEs.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the number: set team objectives against the revenue plan, track monthly, quarterly and annual targets, and report performance to Sales leadership.

- Lead the team: run one-to-ones, call coaching, performance reviews and development plans for SDRs at every level, with clear accountability for results.

- Build enablement: design and run the onboarding curriculum, certification path, call-coaching framework and ongoing skills programs.

- Keep the playbook current: own messaging, objection handling and qualification criteria, and update them with Product Marketing, Marketing and Sales Engineering as products and the market change.

- Hire and scale: partner with Talent Acquisition to run the interview process, set the bar, and onboard new SDRs.

- Run coverage: allocate territories, accounts and resources across the team, and adjust as segments and priorities shift.

- Manage with data: use Salesforce and Gong to diagnose performance, run call reviews, improve conversion, ramp time and meeting quality, and agree hand-off and pipeline standards with AE leadership.

ABOUT YOU

You're a manager who still gets on the phone. When a rep is stuck, you show them what good sounds like rather than describing it. You like building the system as much as running the team: a curriculum, a certification, a playbook new hires can actually use. Stream is a scale-up, so priorities move and not everything is defined yet. If you want a finished sales machine to manage, this probably isn't the role. If you want to build one, it is.

YOU HAVE:

- 1+ years managing a sales development or inside sales team, with direct accountability for team quota

- 3+ years in SaaS sales, including time as an SDR or in a comparable outbound role

- Experience building or substantially improving enablement assets: onboarding programs, playbooks, certification or coaching frameworks

- A track record of hiring, ramping and retaining early-career sales talent

- Fluency with Claude, Salesforce, Gong and modern prospecting and engagement tools, and the habit of managing performance with data

- A hands-on coaching style, with the credibility to get on a call and set the standard yourself

BONUS POINTS:

- Growing an outbound team at an API-led, developer-focused or infrastructure SaaS company

- Formal sales enablement experience, or owning an enablement function alongside a management role

- Managing across US and EMEA time zones

- Embedding a sales methodology (MEDDIC, Command of the Message or similar) in a curriculum

- Experience as an SDR at a high-growth company

title: Forensic Analyst
description:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. Our global Forensics team collects, preserves, and analyzes the data that legal matters depend on, and it runs around the clock across the US, EMEA, and APAC
As a Forensic Analyst based in India, you join the India-based group of that global team and work US Central hours, including weekends, so our clients have forensic coverage when they need it. You start with high-volume, well-defined work: cloud data collections, mobile device report exports, chain of custody documentation, and ticket triage, all under structured training from the US team. As your skills and certifications build, your ownership grows, from supervised tickets to independent handling of assigned ticket types to standalone weekend coverage. This is a role for someone who wants to build a career in digital forensics inside a global practice, with a clear path and real responsibility early.
What You'll Be Doing
Collections and Evidence Handling

• Process cloud data collections from Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and similar sources following KLD Standard Operating Procedures.

• Generate mobile device report exports from forensic tool outputs (Cellebrite, Oxygen Forensics, Magnet AXIOM, or equivalent).

• Maintain chain of custody documentation and evidence handling logs to the KLD standard, and keep case records and ticket notes complete and current.

• Travel within India for onsite data collection or evidence and media handover when a matter requires it.

Ticket Triage and Weekend Coverage

• Triage, tag, and route incoming forensics tickets in KLD's work management system, and claim and action Tier 1 and Tier 2 requests within SLA, with quality control requests taking priority over new tickets of the same tier.

• Monitor the collections and escalation channels during your shift, and alert the on-duty Weekend Coverage Manager to priority requests.

• Execute time-dependent, scheduled, and prioritized cloud and remote collections during weekend coverage windows.

• Escalate anything client-facing, legally sensitive, or outside a defined SOP to the US team, and provide clear handoff notes at the end of every shift so service continues without interruption.

Learning, Certification, and Growth

• Complete structured training, shadowing, and certification milestones set by the US team, and work independently on each ticket type once certified.

• Contribute to and maintain the internal knowledge base and SOP documentation as you learn.

• Build toward standalone coverage of routine ticket types and, over time, broader collection and analysis work as trust and skills grow.

• Lead with the four values. Client is Always in the Room. Own the Outcome. Better Every Day. Deliver Results Together.

What You Should Already Have

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 to 3 years in digital forensics, IT operations, a helpdesk or ticketing environment, or a similar structured technical role. Strong aptitude and attention to detail can substitute for direct forensics experience.

• Exposure to forensic tools (Cellebrite, Magnet AXIOM, EnCase, FTK, Oxygen Forensics, X-Ways, or similar) is a plus, not a requirement. Training is provided.

• Basic scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) is a plus, not a requirement.

• Strong written English for documentation and ticket notes. Fluent spoken English for daily work with US, UK, and APAC colleagues. Client-facing communication is required at the start.

• Comfortable with a sustained US-aligned night schedule that includes Saturday and Sunday, and able to work independently once certified while following escalation protocols.

• Able and willing to travel within India for onsite collection or media handover as required.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll be a customer-facing member of our Tier 2 support team, handling product issues that require deeper troubleshooting or coordination beyond frontline support.
You’ll use company's procedures and diagnostic tools to investigate issues, guide customers through next steps by phone, email, and SMS, and coordinate with service partners when a field visit is needed. When an issue requires Engineering input, you’ll gather the relevant findings and provide a clear escalation. You’ll remain responsible for customer communication and follow-up as the case moves toward resolution.
What you'll own:

• Troubleshoot known product issues with customers using company's procedures and diagnostic tools.

• Ask effective diagnostic questions, document findings, and determine the appropriate next step.

• Own assigned cases through resolution, including timely customer updates and follow-up.

• Coordinate customers, service partners, and internal teams to arrange field visits and track outcomes.

• Escalate complex issues to Engineering with a clear summary of symptoms, troubleshooting completed, and supporting information.

• Maintain accurate case records in Zendesk, Jira, and other support systems.

• Identify gaps or recurring issues and help improve troubleshooting procedures, support documentation, and tools.

• Work closely with Customer Experience, Field, and Engineering as support processes evolve

Requirements

• 3+ years in customer-facing technical support or remote troubleshooting. Hardware, connected devices, appliances, or field service experience is a strong plus.

• Must have prior US-hours experience.

• Has helped build or standardize processes (SOPs, macros, knowledge base, escalation paths). Can work in gray areas without a script.

• Comfortable talking to both non-technical end users and engineers or field techs.

• Individual contributor, not a team lead, but brings enough seniority.

• Spanish/English bilingual is strongly preferred.

Nice to have:

• HVAC experience is last on the nice-to-have list. Technical aptitude, critical thinking, and phone skills come first.
Benefits
Hireframe provides nearshore and offshore staffing solutions, operating as a remote-first organization with team members located in the United States, Mexico, and the Philippines. Our robust benefits package includes:

title: Care Guide
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
At Teladoc Health , you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
Summary of Position
The Care Guide exists to restore trust, clarity, and continuity in healthcare by serving as a dedicated, relationship-driven partner for members. This role is accountable for the ongoing patient experience , not isolated transactions. It blends concierge-level service, care navigation, health coaching, and foundational medical assistant support into a single, high-trust relationship.

Care Guides are supported by an AI Companion that assists with care delivery by helping summarize interactions, surface insights, anticipate next steps, and streamline follow-up-allowing the Care Guide to spend more time building meaningful member relationships.

While this role incorporates select Health Coach and Medical Assistant capabilities, the Care Guide remains distinct: relationship ownership comes first, with coaching and coordination activities deployed in service of continuity, engagement, and follow-through-not as standalone functions.

This is not call-center support, utilization management, or task-only care coordination. It is a proactive, human-centered role modeled after premium relationship based, concierge services and high-touch clientele relationship management that borrows service standards from luxury hospitality, premium retail, and white-glove client experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
1. Patient Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned panel of members, building longitudinal relationships grounded in trust, reliability, and follow-through.

• Conduct proactive outreach and regular check-ins to assess understanding, progress, barriers, and evolving needs.

• Anticipate next steps in a member’s care journey and reduce friction by absorbing system complexity on their behalf.

• Maintain complete, timely, and accurate documentation of all patient interactions and communications in the EHR and supporting tools.

2. Coaching & Behavior Change Support

• Apply motivational interviewing and coaching techniques to support sustainable behavior change, self-management, and engagement in care.

• Assess member needs related to knowledge, skills, motivation, and barriers; tailor education and support accordingly.

• Reinforce care plans for chronic conditions (e.g., hypertension, diabetes), including lifestyle modification, medication adherence, and home monitoring.

• Hold members accountable to goals through empathetic, supportive follow-up while maintaining a non-judgmental coaching stance.

• Refer members to appropriate education, programs, or clinical support in alignment with evidence-based guidelines.

Coaching is embedded within the ongoing relationship-not delivered as episodic or standalone coaching sessions.

3. Care Coordination & Navigation

• Partner closely with the Care Pod, including clinicians and care team members, to reinforce care plans and follow-up instructions.

• Support care coordination activities, including Scheduling internal and external appointments, facilitating referrals and prior authorizations, Collecting and organizing medical records, & supporting diagnostic testing and specialty care coordination

• Obtain, document, and maintain accurate medical history, biometric data, and relevant clinical information in the EHR.

• Identify social, financial, or access barriers and connect members to appropriate community or internal resources.

• Escalate clinical concerns or complex needs promptly and appropriately to licensed providers.

The Care Guide supports care delivery but does not replace licensed clinical decision-making.

You’ll own its technical direction, roadmap, and delivery while staying hands-on with architecture and the hardest engineering problems. In partnership with the team, you’ll build self-service capabilities for training, deployment, serving, and monitoring so KAYAK teams can ship models safely and at scale.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

 

Role Summary & Impact

As a Manager within Account Services at WPP Media, you will lead day-to-day client and agency relationships while overseeing the delivery of programmatic media strategies and campaigns. You will combine hands-on programmatic knowledge, client-facing communication, operational oversight, and team development to ensure campaigns meet performance goals and strengthen client relationships.

You will guide and develop junior team members, lead client status meetings and strategic conversations, and partner across programmatic, planning, investment, analytics, finance, data, and retail media teams. 

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as a senior day-to-day relationship manager for agency and client partners.

• Lead client status meetings, campaign discussions, and strategic presentations.

• Translate client objectives into clear programmatic strategies and actionable recommendations.

• Oversee campaign setup and execution across trading, financial, targeting, measurement, and analytics workflows.

• Monitor performance against KPIs, pacing, optimization goals, budget delivery, and profitability.

• Identify campaign trends, efficiencies, and opportunities to improve performance or expand investment.

• Apply knowledge of DSPs, verification partners, data providers, and retail media platforms to campaign strategy.

• Partner with internal teams to ensure accurate tagging, tracking, reporting, and campaign measurement.

• Act as an escalation point for account, client, and campaign-related issues.

• Provide day-to-day guidance, training, and development to Senior Associate and Associate-level team members.

• Delegate work effectively, balance team priorities, and maintain clear accountability across deliverables.

• Support the development of programmatic and consumer packaged goods best practices as the team and practice continue to grow.

• Educate clients and agency partners on programmatic capabilities, emerging opportunities, and relevant marketplace developments.

• Identify opportunities to grow existing relationships through new channels, audiences, data solutions, and test-and-learn initiatives.

Skills & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• 3+ years of relevant experience in programmatic media, digital advertising, account services, or a related discipline.

• Programmatic agency experience is strongly preferred.

• Prior experience managing day-to-day client relationships, presenting recommendations, and leading status meetings.

• Working knowledge of one or more DSPs, such as The Trade Desk, DV360, or Amazon DSP.

• Understanding of programmatic campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and measurement.

• Familiarity with CM360 tagging and tracking processes.

description:
SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER
📍 MANCHESTER (HYBRID, UP TO 4 DAYS WFH)

💰 £50K-£65K DOE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK, building the technology estate and letting agents use to run their businesses.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own onboarding for Street.co.uk http://Street.co.uk, our sales and lettings CRM. Switching CRM is a big decision for an estate agency. It means moving years of data, setting up branches, roles and permissions, and getting every agent confident from day one. That makes onboarding one of the most important areas for our growth, and we're rethinking all of it.

You'll own the end-to-end journey, from the moment an agency signs to the point their team is running their business on Street.co.uk http://Street.co.uk. You won't be handed a brief. You'll find the problems, decide what matters most, and work with our onboarding team, PMs, engineers, support and commercial to fix them.

How we work:

- Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and test a prototype the same day. We don't guess; we ask.

- We don't believe in rigid, box-ticking processes. Sometimes you need a deep discovery phase; sometimes you just need to trust your intuition and ship. We trust you to know the difference.

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON AS AN L5 SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER AT STREET GROUP

- Partner with PMs and Engineers to shape the roadmap and decide what we build next. You'll identify problem areas worth solving and propose them - not wait for them to land in your queue.

- Define what success looks like before you ship. Measure how it performs after release using analytics, support data and customer feedback. Adjust.

- Jump on calls with users or visit them in-branch to understand pain points and test new workflows.

- Move from low-fi sketches to high-fidelity prototypes - picking the right tool and fidelity for the job, whether that's Figma, paper, or a Claude Code prototype.

- Leverage an AI-native, code-first workflow: use tools like Claude Code to "vibe code" small UI tweaks directly in the live product, get instant answers on technical constraints without waiting on engineers, and iterate your designs in the actual browser to drastically speed up feedback loops.

- Bring AI thinking to what we build, not just how we build it - design AI experiences in the product where they genuinely help users, and call them out where they'd be gimmicks.

WHY YOU SHOULD (AND SHOULDN'T) APPLY

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

- You want to own design end-to-end for significant work in your area - research through to shipping and measuring impact.

- You think from first principles and don't apply "standard" patterns blindly. You ask questions that narrow down the solution space and aren't afraid to challenge the status quo when you've got the evidence to back it up.

- You want to ship work that is polished, intuitive, and sets a new standard for the industry.

- You're commercially fluent - you understand that the user-optimal design isn't always the commercially right one, and you can make that trade-off without losing sleep.

- You've designed for complex products, and you care about the whole service, not just the screens.

YOU PROBABLY SHOULDN'T APPLY IF:

- You prefer a strict, repetitive rhythm or a linear process without ambiguity, as you will find our pace stressful.

- You prefer to design in a silo. We challenge each other constantly to get the best result, so if you don't like engineers or PMs questioning your process, this isn't the place.

- You need to be told exactly what to do. We provide support, but we need people who see a problem and proactively chase the solution.

- You ship and move on. We expect you to define success upfront and check how the work performed after release.

A BIT ABOUT YOU

- Experience: Roughly 5+ years of Product/UX Design experience (SaaS or complex product experience is a bonus).

title: CapEx Commodity Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE SUPPLY CHAIN TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Supply gigawatt-scale compute, the largest build out of compute in history. Qualify and dual-source across every critical equipment category, with lead-time and capacity thresholds tied directly to the forward build pipeline.

- Make supply chain the reason we build faster than anyone. Our modular build redefines speed in this industry, and it lives or dies on supply chain. Keep procurement permanently off the critical path so schedule compression stays our advantage, not our constraint.

- Build the most accurate supply chain prediction modelling that exists. Use the frontier of AI to forecast lead times, demand, and disruption with a precision the industry has never had, and turn that foresight into a structural edge.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own sourcing strategy for capital equipment across the build program, from long-lead power and cooling equipment to modular structures, with total cost of ownership models that hold up against supplier pushback.

- Run competitive sourcing events for capital packages, evaluating suppliers on price, capacity, lead time, warranty, and financial health, and carry each award through to contract signature.

- Negotiate and execute capital equipment agreements, framework agreements, and pricing amendments, coordinating with Legal and Finance on payment milestones, warranties, liquidated damages, and escalation terms.

- Partner with Finance on CapEx planning, tracking committed spend against budget and forecasting cash flow from award to delivery.

title: Especialista em Desenvolvimento (Back-end - Java)
description:
Na Zup , acreditamos que o futuro é construído por pessoas que desafiam o presente. Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que transformam o mercado e elevam a experiência dos nossos clientes. Valorizamos o crescimento contínuo dos Zup pers, incentivando cada pessoa a trilhar caminhos que impulsionem sua evolução profissional. Por meio do Processo Seletivo Interno (PSI), você pode explorar novas tecnologias, projetos e oportunidades de carreira.
O que você fará por aqui

• Liderar a implementação de soluções técnicas para desenvolvimento backend, atuando na modernização e descomissionamento de sistemas legados (API Casca).

• Propor melhorias tecnológicas e apoiar times em tomadas de decisão estratégicas durante refinamentos e sprints.

• Projetar e manter pipelines CI/CD de alta complexidade, integrando múltiplos serviços em ambientes distribuídos.

• Assegurar práticas avançadas de observabilidade, monitoramento e SRE, utilizando ferramentas como Datadog.

• Atuar na padronização da segurança e escalabilidade de aplicações backend em ambiente cloud (AWS) e Kubernetes.

• Conduzir o design e a implementação de APIs críticas, promovendo a adoção de padrões organizacionais

O que esperamos que você saiba

• Experiência avançada em Java e Python para desenvolvimento backend.

• Prática com arquitetura de microsserviços orquestrados e coreografados, utilizando Kubernetes.

• Vivência com sistemas de mensageria em tempo real (Kafka). - Sólidos conhecimentos em Cloud (AWS).

• Experiência em implementação e monitoramento com Datadog.

• Capacidade de liderar code reviews, refatorações e resolução de conflitos de código com Git.

• Domínio de estruturas de dados, algoritmos e análise de trade-offs para sistemas de alta carga.

O que acontece após minha aplicação na vaga interna?

Confirmada sua candidatura e analisado que seu perfil faz sentido para a posição escolhida, comunicaremos via e-mail a liderança e BP imediatos sobre sua aplicação em seleção interna.

Quer entender mais sobre os detalhes, acesse a página de Vagas Internas na Zup net.

title: Utilization Management Specialist
description:
Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence! Cedars-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 times for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We also were awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We offer an outstanding benefits package that includes health care, paid time off, and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.
What You Will Do in This Role:
The Utilization Management Specialist provides advanced operational and workflow support to Utilization Review (UR) Nurses to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of the utilization review process. This position performs complex, non-clinical functions that directly support payer communication, authorization coordination, documentation integrity, and regulatory compliance.
The Utilization Management Specialist maintains an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with multiple UR Nurses and is accountable for oversight of authorization workflows from initial submission, follow-up through to final determination. The role applies independent judgment in prioritizing cases based on payer deadlines, regulatory requirements, and authorization expiration risk.
In collaboration with UR Nurses, Case Management, Revenue Cycle, and external payers, the Utilization Management Specialist ensures documentation and authorization activities are complete, accurate, and executed within established timeframes. This position plays a critical role in supporting revenue integrity, denial prevention, and compliance with CMS and payer specific requirements.
The role operates in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment using EPIC/CS-Link, AIDIN, payer portals, and related UM systems to proactively manage workflows and remove administrative barriers that could delay review completion or payer communication.

• Maintain an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with UR Nurses to support timely utilization review activities.

• Prepare and assemble clinical review packets and supporting documentation for payer submission.

• Review records to confirm required documentation elements are present prior to submission and escalate gaps to the assigned UR Nurse.

• Track submission confirmations and ensure timely follow up on pending payer determinations.

• Manage the authorization lifecycle for assigned cases, including entry, tracking, follow up, documentation of determinations, and monitoring of payer response timelines.

• Monitor payer portals and contact payers directly, as needed, to obtain authorization updates and resolve status discrepancies.

• Independently prioritize cases based on submission deadlines, authorization expiration risk, and regulatory timeframes.

• Escalate urgent authorization issues, delays, or barriers that may result in avoidable denials or authorization lapses.

• Coordinate peer to peer scheduling logistics and maintain related documentation.

• Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials, in EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.

• Identify patterns or systemic authorization workflow issues and communicate trends to UM leadership.

• Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials.

• Ensure all required documentation is accurately entered into EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.

• Communicate effectively with internal and external partners to ensure patient and authorization information is current and complete.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply.  Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale makes it simple for organizations to securely connect people, devices, and workloads anywhere in the world. As adoption grows within the world’s largest enterprises, we’re launching a Strategic Sales team to support our next stage of growth.

As a founding Strategic Account Executive, you’ll own a focused portfolio of organizations with 10,000+ employees, including Fortune 1000 and Global 2000 companies. You’ll lead complex opportunities from initial engagement through close and expansion, building executive relationships and connecting customer priorities with Tailscale’s capabilities.

You’ll help define how we win in this market - developing outbound strategies, testing new approaches, and creating a playbook for future growth. Reporting to the Director of Strategic Sales, you’ll join a small, highly collaborative team and partner closely with executive leadership and teams across the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Own account strategy: Build account plans that connect customer priorities with opportunities across business units, geographies, and use cases

• Create pipeline: Drive personalized outbound prospecting, partnering with SDRs and Marketing on coordinated account-based campaigns

• Lead complex deals: Manage opportunities through negotiation and close, navigating long sales cycles, competitive pursuits, and complex buying processes

• Build executive relationships: Earn trust with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and senior technical and business leaders while developing champions across the organization

• Bring the right team together: Partner with Customer Engineering, GTM Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, executive leadership, Legal, and Finance to win and grow strategic accounts

• Shape the playbook: Test approaches, share what works, and bring customer feedback to teams shaping Tailscale’s product and enterprise strategy

• Execute with discipline: Maintain clear qualification, accurate forecasts, and actionable account and opportunity plans

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of success as a top-performing enterprise or strategic seller in early stage, high-growth environments

• Proven success selling to organizations with 10,000+ employees and closing complex six and seven-figure SaaS deals

• Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding annual performance targets, with demonstrated YoY growth and sustained results

• The ability to earn executive trust, engage technical stakeholders, and navigate procurement, legal, and financial reviews

• Strong business judgment, clear written and verbal communication, and a collaborative, accountable approach

• Comfort with ambiguity and enthusiasm for building a sales motion while carrying a quota

• Demonstrated commitment to CRM hygiene, including accurate opportunity management, pipeline tracking, and forecast reliability

• Proven ability to lead value-based sales conversations and quantify business impact to build compelling ROI-driven business cases

Preferred experience:

• Serving as an early sales hire or helping build a new enterprise sales motion

description:

The Opportunity

Praxis Precision Medicines is entering a pivotal moment as we prepare for commercialization, and how we build and scale capability across the organization will directly impact our success.     We are seeking a driven and customer-focused Account Specialist to execute in the field and drive commercial performance across a defined territory. This individual will be responsible for engaging healthcare providers, building strong customer relationships, and delivering on commercial objectives.     Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will play a critical role in supporting product launches, driving adoption, and ensuring patients gain access to innovative therapies.  

What You’ll Do  

• Execute territory business plans to achieve and exceed sales goals.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with healthcare providers and key stakeholders.

• Drive product adoption through effective customer engagement and education.

• Navigate complex patient pathways and support access to therapy.

• Partner with Market Access, Strategic Accounts, Patient Services, and Medical teams to optimize customer and patient outcomes.

• Support launch execution, including pre-launch planning and post-launch adoption strategies.

• Leverage insights from the field to inform strategy and improve execution.

• Maintain a high level of product, disease state, and market knowledge.

• Ensure compliance with all regulatory and company policies.

• You think in terms of systems, not silos.

• You balance rigor with speed, knowing when each matters most.

• You hold a high bar for performance, quality, and accountability.

• You collaborate deeply but act with ownership and urgency.

• You are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving impact for patients.

• 5+ years of direct sales experience in CNS or specialty pharmaceuticals.

• Deep understanding of complex patient pathways and specialist prescriber dynamics.

• Participation in a recent product launch highly preferred, including familiarity with pre-launch planning and early market execution.

• Experience with formulary access strategies and early market penetration tactics.

• Experience selling into hospital systems, IDNs, and institutional accounts is a strong plus.

• Understanding of specialty pharmacy and hub services models.

• Demonstrated track record of strong, consistent performance against quota and territory goals.

• Evidence of execution against target metrics with year-over-year improvement.

title: Software Engineer (School of Medicine - Medvitals)
description:
The Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine is seeking a Software Engineer to support the Medvitals Team. The Software Engineer is responsible for the creation, implementation, maintenance, performance, production support and documentation of various departmental and enterprise-wide application systems. This includes but is not limited to the installation, modification, and testing of new and/or upgraded applications (packages or homegrown), operating systems, file structures, hardware, communication devices, and productivity tools. Applies analysis techniques and procedures to gather and then translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and designs. Using functional specifications and designs, produces all or part of the deliverables. Maintains databases and application system code.
Responsible for full life cycle of medium to large sized complex projects; strong technical skills; strong ability to understand complex business processes. Develops solutions based on extensive technical knowledge, skills and experience; influences client towards innovative/integrated solutions.
Specific Duties & Responsibilities

• The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position.

• Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility.

Analysis & Requirement Gatherings

• Define complex business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. Provide written documentation of findings to share with the client and other IT colleagues.

• Gather complex system requirements by meeting with clients and researching existing technology to understand the business requirements and possible solutions for new applications.

Design & Development

• Develop detailed tasks and project plans by analyzing project scope and milestones for complex projects to ensure product is delivered quickly according to software lifecycle standards.

• Write functional/technical specifications from the complex system requirements, putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions.

• Develop/change data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solutions for complex application development tasks.

• Document code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge-base system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve support.

• Provide monitoring and guidance in application design and development to more junior staff.

• Provide thought leadership in designing and developing innovative integrated solutions.

Testing & Documentation

• Test all changes by using the appropriate complex test scenarios to ensure all delivered solutions work as expected and errors are handled in a meaningful way.

• Author and maintain documentation by writing audience-appropriate materials to serve as technical and/or end-user references.

• Mentor junior staff in testing tools and technologies by reviewing their work.
